decision: docs/tkernel-rust-refactoring-plan.md D1-D4 (D1, D2 approved by the user 2026-10-07)

classes.A: observable through the mapped API under conditions Rust can produce: obligation
classes.B2: throwing copy/move/assignment and the partial state it leaves
classes.S: Rust soundness duty created by the unsafe representation (user Hash/Eq/Clone/Drop panic); not OCCT behaviour
classes.RX: Rust-only extension; never OCCT parity credit
classes.D3: panic on caller input or internal error that must become a named failure

findings.consequence: Removing B1-B3/S machinery cannot change any mapped upstream GTest; it changes Rust-side behaviour tests and the notes (and some partial statuses) of the cited API rows.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Runs remaining element destructors, then resumes the first Drop panic. Native: a throwing destructor calls std::terminate (C++11 implicit noexcept), so no native state exists to reproduce.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Remove; let Drop panics follow Rust defaults. Callers: ebtree/removal, indexed_storage/assignment, sparse_array/storage/lifecycle, ubtree/storage/pair.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Defers Rust destructor panics until counts and blocks are restored.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Remove with destructor_unwind.rs; destroy with ordinary Drop.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Opt-in 'native destructor policy' for UBTreeFiller self-assignment during Drop; its own doc says OCCT's destructor domain is noexcept.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Remove the opt-in policy type; keep the ordinary filler (class A Fill order).

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: One raw allocation holding two nodes whose payload lifetime is independent of the block, with deferred destructor panics.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Replace with two owned nodes (Box or arena slots); keep the native tree shape and fill order (class A).

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Tests that a panicking pair assignment leaves the allocation abandoned without drops.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Remove with pair.rs.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Repairs the leaf index when a user hash panics during rebind; defers destructor panics while killing the node.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Keep the native Remove phase order (class A); drop the unwind repair once storage is safe.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Substitute: unlink/assign/relink with relink after a panicking assignment (user Clone/Drop).
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Keep the Standard_DomainError check and order (class A); drop the unwind path with safe storage.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: S: Rust soundness of raw intrusive storage when a user Hash/Eq/Clone/Drop panics; not an OCCT behaviour (native hashers of integral keys do not throw). Disappears with safe index-based storage.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Drop the guard with safe storage.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Rehash relinks; a panicking user hash restores original links.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Keep native rehash order (class A); drop the guard with safe storage.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Rehash with link restore on panic; also panics on a begin_resize error (unwrap_or_else(panic!)).
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Keep native rehash order; return a named failure (D3); drop the guard with safe storage.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Public Rust-only resize_with_progress returns a ResizeInterruption that keeps a partial native rehash after a panic (also macro ordered_resize_interruption.rs).
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Remove the API and its rows' notes; a rehash cannot be interrupted except by a caller bug.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Restores the first unlink if hashing the opposite key panics; panics if the partner bucket is missing (internal invariant).
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Drop the guard with safe storage; keep the invariant assert with a comment (D3 allows documented invariants).

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Rust-only fallible try_retain; removes a dead cell when the user keep callback panics.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Keep try_retain as a Rust-only extension (Result path); drop the panic path with safe storage.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Lets the raw base finish when dropping an owner panics.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Drop with safe storage.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Constructors transfer raw storage ownership only when element initialisation completes; a test hook observes allocation provenance after a panic.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Remove; build with Vec (memory safety is Vec's).

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Inline test: reallocation keeps old values when Default panics.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Remove the test; SmallVec provides memory safety.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Tests that a panicking value constructor releases a typed lease.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Keep only if allocate_value_with is public API that a mapped row claims; otherwise remove.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Exact allocation-boundary traces with injected allocation failure.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Remove the failure injection; keep the success-path bucket traces if a native probe compares them (class A).

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Rehash panic leaves the map unchanged.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Remove.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Rust-only open-trait unwind safety; its doc says OCCT's integral template arguments cannot panic.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Seal PackedInteger to the native integer types; then remove.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Mutation results under injected failure; the success rows are class A.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Keep the success rows; remove the failure injection.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: Its doc: key callbacks are Rust extensions, native source order is the contract.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Keep as Rust-only extension tests only if the callbacks stay public; otherwise remove.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: OSD_ThreadPool performJob: a failing job becomes the Standard_ProgramError the launcher raises.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Keep.

catch_unwind_sites.native_contract: OSD_ThreadPool EnumeratedThread failure capture on a pool thread.
catch_unwind_sites.recommendation: Keep.

unsafe_clusters.class: Hypothesis, to verify per module in Phase 2: A+B5: raw intrusive nodes model native node layout. Class A: node identity seen by detached cursors, bucket/chain and insertion order, allocator statistics a public API reports. Not an obligation: raw addresses (B5) and panic-safety states (S).
unsafe_clusters.recommendation: Phase 2 candidate: index-based safe storage (Vec slots + free list; cursors hold index and generation) that keeps every class-A order; prototype on one family first (base_map/data_map), gated by verify_tkernel.

phase2_order: Remove B1 (destructor_unwind and its four users) and the Rust-only resize_with_progress API (B3+RX).
Remove B2/B3 test modules and the LinearVector constructor ownership tokens; seal PackedInteger.

Prototype safe index storage on base_map/data_map; if verify_tkernel and the differential count hold and unsafe falls, extend family by family (indexed_storage, ordered_table, double_map, list/base_list, sequence, sparse_array_base).
D3: Array1/Array2/IndexedMap index operators and ordered_table resize errors return named failures.
clusters_note: Cluster classes are hypotheses from module structure and docs, not a line-by-line audit; Phase 2 verifies each module before changing it.
